On the real exam, this question asks about **your own** Business Canvas Project. For practice, answer about this sample project.

A student team developed a refurbished-laptop store for high school students for families on a budget. Their hypothesis was that at least 40% of families would choose a refurbished laptop over a new one at 40% off. In a survey of 150 people in the target market, 46% said they would.

Luis earns $4,800 per month before taxes. Payroll deductions total $1,104. Rent is $1,220 per month, and other living expenses average $1,150. Luis has a $1,000 credit card balance at 24% APR and wants to save $11,000 for a car down payment in 22 months.

A media company plans to launch CableFusion Plus, a streaming service, in a market with four established rivals. Its executives reviewed industry publications and the rivals' public financial reports.

Pixel Print Shop has funds for one project. **Option A**: add a premium product line, costing $42,000 and expected to add $10,500 in annual profit. It would also require the owner to manage a new team. **Option B**: expand advertising to a new customer segment, costing $29,000 and expected to add $19,500 in annual profit, with more uncertainty because the business has less experience in this area. The owner's goals are to grow profit, keep risk manageable, and maintain the business's reputation for customer service.
